title: Add your own part
intro: Type the numbers from a datasheet or from your own bench test. The part is saved on this device only.

prop.heading: Propeller
prop.toggle: Fit a propeller to this motor
prop.toggleHint: A propeller needs datasheet rows. Its thrust and power numbers are fitted to them.
prop.name: Name

rows.label: Datasheet rows
rows.hint: One row per line: pack voltage (V), throttle (0 to 1), thrust (g), current (A). Separate with tabs, semicolons or commas. Up to {max} rows.

error.notNumber: Line {line} has a value that is not a number.

fit.heading: Fitted numbers
fit.band: Band ±{percent} %. This is a fit residual, not a tolerance.
fit.needed: Paste at least four datasheet rows that match this motor and propeller to see the fit.
fit.unsettled: The fit did not settle. Check the rows.

pack.heading: Battery
pack.name: Name
pack.rHint: Leave empty to set it from the capacity.

source.heading: Source
source.title: Source title
source.titleHint: The datasheet, test or page the numbers came from. Every part needs one.

license.label: Licence
license.hint: Left empty, the part gets a licence for parts you supply yourself.

issues.heading: To fix
issues.name: The name needs letters or digits.
issues.duplicate: Another part here has the same name.
issues.source: Add where the numbers came from.

blocked.one: {count} thing to fix before you can save.
blocked.other: {count} things to fix before you can save.

save.saved: Saved {names}. It is now in the part picker.
save.conflict: A part with this id and version is already saved with other numbers. Change the version to save this one.
save.failed: The part could not be saved on this device.

compare.title: Compare builds
compare.memoryNote: Pinned builds are kept in this tab only. They are not saved to the project, and a reload clears them.
compare.empty: Pin a build first. Then change a part and come back to see each number side by side.
compare.assumptionsSame: Both builds use the same assumptions.
